issues.title: House scene config module: Sears Craftsman floorplan data
issues.description: New app/lib/houseScenes.ts: declarative floorplan configs from Sears Modern Homes catalogs (Craftsman-era models, e.g. the Ashmore/Valmont bungalows): room rectangles, wall segments with doorways, furniture as oriented boxes (sofa, dining table, chairs, bed, bookshelf, stove) with per-piece dims from period catalogs. Export: rooms[], walls[], furniture[] (name, center, size, rotation), startPose, goals[]. Shared by BOTH robots. Presentation-layer first: walls/furniture render in the three.js stages; kernel-active obstacle slots (scene.obstacleCenterMeters/HalfExtents) map to ONE designated furniture piece per task until kernel multi-obstacle lands (bd-multi-obstacle-kernel). Furniture dims are period-catalog approximations, labeled as such in comments.
issues.close_reason: Implemented app/lib/houseScenes.ts: Craftsman bungalow floorplan (rooms/walls/doorways/furniture/start/goals), per-task arm counter-corner placement mapping, esbuild gate pass.

issues.title: G1 terrain toggle: flat vs terrain-and-push in the flagship UI
issues.description: The kernel already supports G1Challenge::Flat(0) and TerrainAndPush(1) (fs-cmaes-viz-wasm/src/g1_walking.rs:257-266; default Flat at line 322, terrain recovery handling at 616). The UI hard-codes DEFAULT_G1_WALKING_CONFIG (challenge: terrain-and-push). Add a segmented toggle (Flat ground / Terrain + push) near the challenge chip: worker optimize/preview requests carry challenge; worker builds config {...DEFAULT_G1_WALKING_CONFIG, challenge}; evaluator + pool re-created per selection (runs keyed by family:seed:challenge — extend continuation key). TerrainSurface component already renders the heightfield when challenge matches. Verify: toggle switches terrain visually, receipts carry the challenge name, continuation survives toggle switches by keying runs per challenge.
issues.close_reason: Implemented: challenge flows through preview/optimize/compare, per-challenge continuation keys, segmented toggle in the flagship UI. Per-file esbuild gates pass; project tsc blocked by sibling WIP in CAGalleryTrace.tsx (noted, untouched).

issues.title: Ship higher-fidelity robotics scenes, parallel population evaluation, and statistical evidence
issues.description: Consume the next Frankensim robotics contract in the CMA-ES explainer; render richer owner-derived household collision/contact and G1 terrain/push telemetry; add deterministic multi-worker WASM population evaluation with sequential fallback; expose multi-seed all-family benchmark evidence without overclaiming WebGPU or sim-to-real.
issues.acceptance_criteria: All changed controls visibly alter owner physics; worker pool proves objective equality against sequential evaluation; browser displays execution source and statistical receipts; typecheck, lint, tests, build, desktop/mobile smoke, and retained profiling evidence pass.
issues.close_reason: Completed: v0.6.6 robotics owner integration, terrain/push and collision/contact pedagogy, bit-exact worker fan-out, retained browser profiling, and all site gates pass

issues.title: Make the 5,040-D G1 flagship optimize the behavior users actually see
issues.description: The current worker trains on a 0.25 s rollout with only 16–64 evaluations, then replays for 1.5 s. The zero policy terminates around 19/180 steps and the UI still frames this as learning to walk. Diagnose termination from first principles, stabilize the honest baseline, align training and replay objectives, choose a credible responsive budget, expose survival/termination diagnostics, and verify all scalable families through the owner WASM path.
issues.close_reason: Completed: corrected the Frankensim G1 contact model and termination contract, aligned training and replay over the full 1.5 s horizon, shipped v0.5.6 immutable WASM, exposed baseline/termination diagnostics, verified all four CMA families, and proved a real 20-generation separable run beats baseline and reaches the 720-step horizon.

issues.title: Eliminate nondeterministic clocks and random sources from remaining visualizations
issues.description: The Three.js visualization validator still reports wall-clock or unseeded random behavior in CAGalleryTrace, CmaesInternalsLab, CovarianceScene, EncodeDecodePlayground, NoiseExplorer, RestartStrategyViewer, cmaesEngine, and cmaesEngineND. These findings predate and are outside the verified G1 flagship path, but they make screenshots/replays less reproducible and prevent the fleet-wide validator from going green.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Replace each simulation-affecting performance.now/Math.random use with an explicit seeded or virtual-time owner; retain wall clock only for labeled UI runtime measurements; add deterministic replay tests for affected generators; run validate-viz.py with zero determinism errors; keep CMA optimization behavior and interactive controls unchanged.
issues.close_reason: Seeded every simulation-affecting Math.random in CAGalleryTrace, CmaesInternalsLab, RestartStrategyViewer, runRandomSearch, and the arm worker; locked rAF-timestamp virtual clock in the CAGalleryTrace render loop; 5 deterministic replay tests added; validate-viz.py reports 0 determinism findings; bun test -t deterministic 5/5 pass; bun lint clean. Wall-clock retained only for labeled UI/runtime measurements (WASM probe, Date.now elapsed).

Vercel-side is already correct: cmaes.org + www.cmaes.org attached to cmaes_explainer, Vercel DNS records (ALIAS -> cname.vercel-dns.com, CAA, etc.) present.
